# Open Ethics Standard

> A public standard with hosted and local MCP tools for reviewing possible harmful software practices. No OES login or API key is required.

- [Agent setup guide](https://ike5.github.io/open-ethics-standard/agent-setup.md): Connect to the hosted OES MCP or build a local option, then verify the tools.
- [Hosted MCP](https://mcp.codebylevel.com/mcp): Public Streamable HTTP endpoint.
- [Project and source](https://github.com/ike5/open-ethics-standard): MCP source code and contribution instructions.
- [The standard](https://github.com/ike5/open-ethics-standard/blob/main/OPEN-ETHICS-STANDARD.md): Canonical practice definitions.
